parsed.title: Southeastern Illinois College | Providing Quality Education
headings: If you want a degree program that saves you time and money, then you'll find it at SIC.
IT'S YOUR FUTURE WE'LL MAKE IT POSSIBLE.
Did you know? The price of a four-year university can be up to 5 times more expensive than SIC.
SIC ranks among the top 150 community colleges in the nation.
Prepare for life after college with career-ready programs.
80% of SIC students receive some form of financial aid.
At Southeastern Illinois College, we give you the tools you need to succeed.
Get the inside look at life at Southeastern Illinois College.
